layers.process: Rubondo Island National Park: The park guide says walks must be accompanied by authorised rangers or guides and stay on marked paths. Confirm current arrangements directly with the park.
Rubondo Island National Park: Land boats only at designated points; transfers are typically arranged with the park or licensed operators. Check current lake conditions and boat arrangements.
Rubondo Island National Park: Special campsites require advance reservation. Fishing, where offered, is controlled and may require permits; confirm conditions directly.

laws.rule: Rubondo Island National Park: Land only at designated points. Walking must be with authorised rangers/guides; follow boating speed/no-wake zones and do not disturb wildlife. Fishing, where offered, is controlled and may be catch-and-release with permits; no universal fishing entitlement is inferred. The guide explicitly identifies Geita Region.
